verdict.rationale: Pipedream versions its REST API with a /v1 base URL and a versioned OpenAPI 3.0.4 spec (2.0.0). It also keeps a dated changelog and an SDK migration guide that commits to not deprecating the 1.x TypeScript SDK. That commitment covers the SDK only, and the evidence says no API-wide versioning or deprecation policy page exists. missing for 10: a documented API-wide deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, support windows for old API versions), independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The REST API base URL is versioned (/v1).
there are no plans to deprecate the `1.x` TypeScript SDK, so if you've already implemented that version, make sure to read through the migration guide
Pipedream publishes its REST API as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.4 document (info title "Pipedream REST API", version 2.0.0, server https://api.pipedream.com)
